groups.label: Holds
groups.what: Each hold covers the party's tables, starts between service start and the build, ends at arrival, and its covers lost stay in bounds.

groups.label: Server sections
groups.what: Each placed party names the section(s) it lands in.

groups.label: Aisle clearance
groups.what: No join narrows an aisle below the venue minimum; rejected sets say why.

groups.label: Can't-fit answers
groups.what: A party that can't be seated gets one line with the size, the time and the earliest option.

groups.label: Activity log
groups.what: Every AI action and manager decision is logged; guest and host text only as a hash.

groups.label: Request chat
groups.what: Chat changes stay proposals until applied, and never name a table the solver didn't pick.

groups.label: Floor edits by conversation
groups.what: The AI only names operations; code places, checks (R1–R11) and re-plans; refusals and plan-state answers are code.
